messages:
maria-evans: Heads-up — BridgeBank SIG is due EOD Thursday (they want per-question evidence). Starting thread to assign Qs.

lee-park: I can take Q1-10 (network & infra). Will gather diagrams + firewall rules export.

sam-chen: I'll own Q11-30 (auth, secrets, keys). Need KMS rotation doc, key policy, and proof of rotation.

jordan: I'll do Q31-60 (data handling, backups, incident). Will grab backup retention table and DR test report.

maria-evans: Specific asks: Q14 asks for 'encryption at rest for PII' — provide KMS CMK policy + screenshot of key rotation history. File names ideally: kms_rotation_2026-03.pdf, cmk_policy.txt

sam-chen: got it. I'll attach cmk_policy.txt and export of AWS CloudTrail events for key rotation. Also, here's the IAM snippet they asked for (Q22 vendor access):

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["s3:GetObject"], "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-prod-evidence/*"], "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"aws:PrincipalOrgID": "o-xxxxxxxx"}}}
  ]
}
```

lee-park: For network, I'll export firewall rules: `gcloud compute firewall-rules export --format=json > fw_rules_bridgebank.json` and sketch of VPC topology.

jordan: Q45 (MFA for admins) — we should include Conditional Access screenshot and SCIM provisioning doc. I'll grab admin-login logs sample (redact IPs).

security-bot: Reminder: Redact customer PII before upload. Use /tools/redact v2.1

maria-evans: Timeline: owners upload evidence to `s3://redwood-sales/bridgebank/sig-evidence/` by Wed 17:00 PT. I'll consolidate and generate single zip: `bridgebank_sig_package_2026-03-xx.zip`

ops-bot: Auto note — ticket #SR-4521 created to track uploads. Link: https://linear.app/rw/issue/SR-4521

sam-chen: One Q: BridgeBank asked for SOC2 audit report — we have SOC2 v2024.pdf. @maria-evans okay to include?

maria-evans: Yes include SOC2 v2024 (redacted). Also include our data residency statement for Q39.

lee-park: Uploads done for Q1-10: `fw_rules_bridgebank.json`, `vpc_diagram_bridgebank.png` (s3 link: https://internal.s3/redwood/bridgebank/fw_rules_bridgebank.json)

sam-chen: Uploaded: `cmk_policy.txt`, `kms_rotation_2026-03.pdf`, `iam_vendor_policy_snippet.json`, `soc2_v2024_redacted.pdf`

jordan: Uploaded: `backup_retention_2025-2026.csv`, `dr_test_report_2025.pdf`, `ca_conditional_access.png`

maria-evans: Thanks all. I'll run quick QA pass tomorrow morning and attach the final zip to the sales portal.

lee-park: :thumbsup:

sam-chen: :+1: ping me if legal needs different redaction

jordan: noted. I'll keep the audit copies in /secure-team/bridgebank until closure.

maria-evans: Closing checklist: verify filenames, redact, validate links. If anything missing ping thread.

lee-park: ack

security-bot: Upload scan complete — no secrets detected in uploaded files (scan id: scan-98321)

maria-evans: Last_message — 11:03 PT: final zip created `bridgebank_sig_package_2026-03-18.zip` and uploaded to sales portal. Ticket SR-4521 moved to 'Ready for customer'.
